linkedin.title: 6922 - QA Automation Engineer
linkedin.snippet:
Work Mode: 100% On-site
Employment Type: Full-time
About the Role


We are looking for an experienced QA Automation Engineer to design, build, and maintain scalable test automation solutions across web, mobile, and API platforms. This role will focus on improving test coverage, reliability, and efficiency while integrating automated testing into modern CI/CD workflows.





Requisitos



 
Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

 
5+ years of Software Quality Assurance experience, with a strong focus on test automation.

 
Proficiency in at least one programming or scripting language such as Python, Java, JavaScript, or C#.

 
Hands-on experience with automation tools/frameworks such as Selenium, Cypress, Playwright, Appium, TestNG, or JUnit.

 
Strong understanding of RESTful API testing, SQL, and test data management.

 
Experience with CI/CD tools and Git-based version control.

 
Familiarity with Agile/Scrum development methodologies.

Responsibilities

 
Design, develop, and maintain scalable and reusable test automation frameworks.

 
Create and execute automated tests for web applications, mobile applications, and APIs.

 
Integrate automated test suites into CI/CD pipelines using tools such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, or Azure DevOps.

 
Collaborate with Developers, Product Managers, and QA Engineers to define test strategies, acceptance criteria, and automation coverage.

 
Perform code reviews and promote best practices for test automation, maintainability, and quality.
 
 
Analyze automated test results, perform root-cause analysis, and collaborate with technical teams to drive defects through resolution.

 
Continuously improve test coverage, execution efficiency, stability, and reliability.

 
Mentor and support junior QA Engineers in automation tools, frameworks, and best practices.
